scope: Dead code / legacy cleanup only with proof — dynamic, registry and worker coupling included.
decision: Stage 57 cleanup analysis is complete for current main. Passport/passport-discord remain the only proven broad removal from this wave; registry-driven, dynamically imported, command-loaded, AI-tool and Nitrado-worker surfaces are proven reachable and must not be mass-deleted.

contracts.proofRequired: dynamic imports, filesystem command loading, Discord dispatch, workers, AI tools, Nitrado jobs and registry-driven modules are part of deletion reachability
contracts.noRegression: prefer keep over guess; deletion requires executable or runtime-code evidence of unreachability
contracts.completedRemovals: passport + passport-discord unused direct deps removed Stage 54
contracts.forbidden: no deleting registry-driven modules based on static import graph alone
contracts.currentMainBinding: Stage 57 analysis is bound to main 425cf4d7b70a9e417d1c6a6a9622e6330f9ceea9
contracts.couplingBaseline: docs/audit/structure-coupling-map.json is the audited coupling inventory; Stage 57 revalidates its deletion-sensitive runtime anchors on current main

analysis.entryAndSchedulers: src/index.ts explicitly mounts Discord events, dashboard, Nitrado runtime, AI background loops and application schedulers; guild lifecycle also contains dynamic imports
analysis.commands: src/commands/handler.ts filesystem-loads command directories with require(), so static-import-only orphan detection is invalid for command modules
analysis.interactionDynamics: src/events/interactionCreate.ts dynamically imports feedback, ticket, lottery, self-role and whitelist handlers from component IDs
analysis.aiTools: src/modules/ai/toolRuntime.ts registers production tools through registerProductionTools() and executeProductionAiTool() provides the canonical runtime path
analysis.nitrado: src/modules/nitrado/runtime.ts starts/stops the durable Nitrado worker and related crons; jobWorker.ts dispatches the known operation registry
analysis.couplingMap: docs/audit/structure-coupling-map.json records runtime-code HTTP mounts, bootstrap starts and domain chains including Nitrado whitelist/ban producers and consumers
